learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to independently analyze, structure, plan, implement, and critically evaluate a complex engineering research or development project as a team, with regard to goal achievement.
Systematically question, refine, and translate incomplete or diffuse tasks into verifiable project goals.
Justifiably select and apply suitable methods from research, development, and project management.
Consistently define and document project structure, work packages, time planning, resources, and responsibilities.
Document technical, organizational, and, if applicable, experimental results in a comprehensible manner.
Present and defend project results in written and oral form in an audience-appropriate manner.

Successfully deal with complex tasks from research and industrial development under realistic boundary conditions (e.g., uncertainty, conflicting goals, limited resources) and be prepared for further project, research, or master's theses.

syllabus_topics: Analysis and specification of the task and derivation of project goals
Selection and application of suitable development, research, or project management methods
Structuring the project into work packages including time and resource planning
Processing technical questions (e.g., conception, modeling, simulation, experiment, implementation)
Documentation of the procedure and results
Presentation and discussion of project results
assessment_rules: Assessment is based on a practical project, a written project report (student paper), and an oral presentation of project results. All assessment components relate to the same project and evaluate both the outcome and the methodological approach.
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Maschinenbau (M.Sc.)
